scripts.verify: npm test && npm run test:go && npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:sidecar
scripts.build:sidecar: mkdir -p build/sidecar/local && GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false go build -o build/sidecar/local/workspace-sidecar ./cmd/workspace-sidecar
scripts.build:sidecar:mac: mkdir -p build/sidecar/darwin-arm64 && GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 go build -o build/sidecar/darwin-arm64/workspace-sidecar ./cmd/workspace-sidecar
scripts.build:sidecar:win: mkdir -p build/sidecar/win32-x64 && GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -o build/sidecar/win32-x64/workspace-sidecar.exe ./cmd/workspace-sidecar
scripts.build:sidecars: npm run build:sidecar:mac && npm run build:sidecar:win
scripts.format: oxfmt electron/developmentRuntime.js scripts/dev-desktop.mjs scripts/component-catalog.mjs scripts/verify-desktop.mjs src/stories .ladle src/styles.css package.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt electron/developmentRuntime.js scripts/dev-desktop.mjs scripts/component-catalog.mjs scripts/verify-desktop.mjs src/stories .ladle src/styles.css package.json --check
